text:
Please contact your vet or a pet poison control service right now, before anything else. Tell them your dog ate some pothos, roughly how much, and when. Pothos is not pet-safe, so don't wait to see if symptoms appear. If your vet is closed, an emergency vet clinic can help.

I can't give medical advice on treatment, so follow what the vet or poison control tells you. Once your dog is taken care of, I can help with anything on the Leafy side, like pet-safe plant options (calathea, spider plant, parlour palm, Boston fern and peperomia are listed as pet-safe).
